http:response.http:headers: #[{ "X-Request-ID": vars.requestId default "", "Idempotent-Replayed": if (vars.replayed default false) "true" else "false" }]

flow-ref.name: begin-run
flow-ref.doc:name: 実行を登録（冪等キー・行員トークン）

ee:transform.doc:name: 全銀データを検証・分解

choice.doc:name: 検証 NG なら取り込まない

raise-error.description: 全銀データの形式・件数・合計金額に誤りがあるため、取り込みませんでした。

set-variable.doc:name: 結果を蓄積
set-variable.value: #[vars.coreResults ++ (vars.chunk map (c, i) -> { line: c.line, accountNo: c.request.accountNo, amount: c.request.amount as Number, referenceNo: c.request.referenceNo, status: payload[i].status, note: payload[i].note })]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var all = (vars.coreResults ++ vars.mapped.rejected) orderBy $.line fun count(s) = sizeOf(all filter ($.status == s)) --- { runId: vars.runId, senderBankCode: vars.zengin.header.senderBankCode, remitterNameKana: vars.zengin.header.remitterNameKana, tradeDate: vars.zengin.header.tradeDate, records: sizeOf(vars.zengin.records), totalAmount: vars.zengin.totalAmount, summary: { credited: count("CREDITED"), held: count("HELD"), duplicate: count("DUPLICATE"), rejected: count("REJECTED") }, results: all }

set-variable.value: #[payload.senderBankCode ++ ' ' ++ payload.records ++ ' 件：入金 ' ++ payload.summary.credited ++ '・保留 ' ++ payload.summary.held ++ '・重複 ' ++ payload.summary.duplicate ++ '・対象外 ' ++ payload.summary.rejected]
